items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Is that one of the Goodson girls by any chance? Did you know them? Goodson? ... [INTERVIEWEE] You know Billy Pierce ... [INTERVIEWER] she was a Goodson? ... [INTERVIEWEE] from Pensacola

ctx.x: and I found it I wish I had known around there that Lee Collins and Oil were always good buddies and those guys had a real good Dixieland band so Joe Wynn liked to took a stole Edmund Hall from that group and took Alvin Morgan from that group and put them with us and we picked up on a piano player that lived in that town named Helen Jackson her mid name was Helen Jackson Goodreads no no before that I forgot there was another woman another woman played piano player I can't think of her name right now but we used…
Is that one of the Goodson girls by any chance? Did you know them? Goodson?
